text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Triple Tiara behind us,<n>Mejiro Dober and I
set our sights on<n>the next race—the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It won't be an easy race, considering<n>its distance
and the caliber of her<n>opponents, but it will be a
great<n>experience for her upcoming<n>challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I half expect Mejiro Dober to be<n>nervous, but
instead, she's thrilled to<n>be entering the same race
as her<n>beloved upperclassman, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Mejiro Dober is<n>surprised to
learn she placed third in<n>the Arima Kinen's pre-race
popularity<n>poll.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While the other Mejiro members<n>celebrate her
selection, Mejiro Dober<n>vows to run a race worthy
of a new<n>Mejiro legacy.
